raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.21.0"

package:
  name: pygments
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pygments/pygments-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 610ca751c9bc2492b38eb9a38a7fbc93edbbb2d7182edaf34e66ae493dee5c8c

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - pygmentize = pygments.cmdline:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling >=1.27
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pygments
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - pygmentize --help

about:
  summary: Pygments is a syntax highlighting package written in Python.
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pygments.org
  repository: https://github.com/pygments/pygments
  documentation: https://pygments.org/docs

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jakirkham
    - pelson
    - ocefpaf
    - scopatz
